projects.name: Northwind

decisions.title: Use disclosure behavior for nested mobile navigation
decisions.rationale: More predictable keyboard and focus behavior than a custom drawer-only pattern.

decisions.title: Keep active implementation isolated from the production-like environment
decisions.rationale: Avoids collision with parallel content and QA work.

learnings.title: Resolve interaction semantics before visual QA
learnings.detail: Keyboard and focus decisions are cheaper to settle before visual polish begins.

learnings.title: Handoff notes should name the unresolved decision
learnings.detail: Explicit open questions make context recovery dramatically faster after a gap.

weekly.summary: Navigation moved from exploration into implementation-ready behavior. Remaining risk is mostly coordination, not technical uncertainty.
